name: Sidebar
description:
A docked pane of navigation or details, built from parts. Put it in a SidebarProvider beside
a SidebarInset:

```tsx
<SidebarProvider storageKey="app.sidebar">
  <Sidebar collapsible="icon" aria-label="Workspace">
    <Sidebar.Header icon={<Mark />} title="Northwind" />
    <Sidebar.Content>
      <Sidebar.Group>
        <Sidebar.GroupLabel>Workspace</Sidebar.GroupLabel>
        <Sidebar.Menu>
          <Sidebar.MenuItem>
            <Sidebar.MenuButton icon={<IconHome />} href="/" active>Home</Sidebar.MenuButton>
          </Sidebar.MenuItem>
        </Sidebar.Menu>
      </Sidebar.Group>
    </Sidebar.Content>
    <Sidebar.Rail />
  </Sidebar>
  <SidebarInset>…</SidebarInset>
</SidebarProvider>
```

Parts: `Header`, `Search`, `Content`, `Match`, `Group`, `GroupLabel`, `GroupAction`, `GroupContent`,
`Menu`, `MenuItem`, `MenuButton`, `MenuAction`, `MenuBadge`, `MenuSub`, `MenuSubItem`,
`MenuSubButton`, `MenuSkeleton`, `Separator`, `Footer` and `Rail`.
signature: ({ side, variant, collapsible, resizable, width, minWidth, maxWidth, as: Landmark, "aria-label": label, className, style, children, ...rest }: SidebarProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the landmark and the phone sheet: "Workspace navigation", "Ticket details". Required.

props.name: as
props.description:
The landmark: `nav` for navigation, `aside` for complementary details (an end sidebar with
the selection's properties), or `div` for none.

props.name: children
props.description: The parts: Header, Search, Content, Footer and Rail.

props.name: collapsible
props.description:
`offcanvas`: collapsing slides it fully away. `icon`: it narrows to a strip of icons whose
labels become tooltips and whose sub-menus become flyouts. `none`: always expanded, with
no toggle, shortcut or phone sheet.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: The widest a resize can make it.

props.name: minWidth
props.description: The narrowest a resize can make it.

props.name: resizable
props.description: Let the person drag the Rail (or use its arrow keys) to set the width, within `minWidth` and `maxWidth`. The width is remembered with the provider's storageKey.

props.name: side
props.description: The edge it docks to, following the reading direction: `start` (left in LTR) or `end`.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`sidebar`: a flush chrome pane along the edge. `floating`: a glass panel inset from the
edges with its own corners. `inset`: the sidebar sits on the canvas and SidebarInset is
drawn as the raised panel beside it.

props.name: width
props.description: The expanded width before the person resizes it.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
